newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Christmas Day in Holy Land begins with a jolt.
newsitem.headline: Christmas Day in Holy Land begins with a jolt.

text.p: Christmas Day in the Holy Land began with a jolt on Wednesday when Israelis called radio stations to say their homes had been shaken by what appeared to be a tremor.
There were no reports of injuries.

Israeli army radio said residents began calling shortly after midnight (2200 GMT Tuesday) from areas throughout the country to say the furniture in their homes had been shaken for several seconds. Israel Radio said it received similar phone calls.
The Israeli Seismological Institute was checking the reports. Earthquakes are not all that uncommon in Israel and the rest of the eastern Mediterranean.
Whatever rocked other parts of the Holy Land did not shake Bethlehem, birthplace of Jesus Christ, where a midnight mass was taking place, witnesses said.
